intro: Biggest rank disagreements between the SEI board and SP+, 2026 season: from the SP+ top 15 and from our own top 15.

teams.explanation: SP+'s #34 hinges on a #75 offense; SEI's #12 is carried by a defense allowing nearly nothing on early downs (early pass PPA allowed +2.3 z, 97th percentile) and an offense that almost never gets stuffed (+2.7 z, 99th percentile). The scoreboard lags because the losses were ugly — 41-13 at Notre Dame, 17-7 at UCLA — while the wins trounced Eastern Michigan 54-10 and Michigan State 31-3. A 4-point win at Penn State marks the ceiling SP+ sees.
hints: Process outran scoreboard: margin rank #39 (margin +38) but SEI #12.
SP+ halves: off #75, def #14.
Strongest metrics: Stuffed +2.69, Early pass PPA +2.32, Fum% +1.86.
Weakest metrics: Pen -2.87, Stuff -2.43.

teams.explanation: Six wins, +100 margin, SP+ at #7 with an #8 offense. SEI's #28 follows its #50 defense: Havoc -1.2 z (10th percentile) and forced fumbles -1.0 z — no negative plays — while its own run game gets stuffed at an awful rate (-2.2 z). The record hides seams: only 27-24 at Colorado, 41-24 over Kansas, 31-17 at Iowa State. SP+ buys the offense; our board doesn't.
hints: Scoreboard outran process: margin rank #14 (margin +100) but SEI #28.
Defense drives the gap: SEI off #19 vs def #50.
SP+ halves: off #8, def #13.
Strongest metrics: Early rush PPA +2.08, 3rd pass PPA +1.73, Pts/drive +1.62.
Weakest metrics: Stuffed -2.22.

teams.explanation: Both boards see an elite defense — SP+ #10, ours #22, with 99th-percentile early-down rush defense (+2.2 z) and points-per-drive allowed (+2.1 z). The gap is offense: SEI #48 versus SP+ #33. Missouri's fourth-down aggression sits at -1.3 z and penalty yardage at -1.2 z, and the scoreboard agreed: 31-24 at Mississippi State and 31-3 at Ole Miss. SP+ averages the season; we weigh what the offense actually did.
hints: Offense drives the gap: SEI off #48 vs def #22.
SP+ halves: off #33, def #10.
Strongest metrics: Early rush PPA +2.19, Pts/drive +2.10, 3rd rush PPA +1.65.

teams.explanation: SP+ sees #1 offense, #1 defense. Our #8 reflects two games SP+ forgave: a 24-23 loss at Texas and a 19-15 win at Indiana. The metrics echo it — third-down pass PPA is 3rd percentile (-2.0 z), and penalties are constant (-1.5 z on both rate and yards). Early-down passing (+2.1 z) and forced fumbles (+1.7 z) still make them the Big Ten's best; we just won't double-count 56-3 and 59-3 wins over Ball State and Kent State.
hints: SP+ halves: off #1, def #1.
Strongest metrics: Early pass PPA +2.06, AR +1.93, Fum% +1.74.
Weakest metrics: 3rd pass PPA -2.02, Pen yd -1.56, Pen -1.52.

teams.explanation: SEI's #2 is built on defensive process SP+ underrates: early-down pass PPA allowed +2.6 z (99th percentile), sack rate +2.5 z, Havoc +2.3 z. The +123 margin includes 51-10 over Clemson and 35-6 over Texas A&M. SP+'s #9 anchors on two one-score losses — 32-24 at Ole Miss and 35-34 at Kentucky — which the underlying metrics read as variance, not truth.
hints: SP+ halves: off #13, def #10.
Strongest metrics: Early pass PPA +2.60, Sack% +2.53, Havoc +2.27.

teams.explanation: Miami is 6-0 at +137 margin and SP+ says #4. Our #26 defense says the margin is flattered by mismatch games — 77-7 over Florida A&M — while real tests ran looser: 33-20 at Wake Forest, 43-35 over Florida State, with defensive Havoc at -1.0 z (16th percentile). The offense is genuinely good (early-down pass PPA +2.0 z, points per drive +1.8 z); the defense hasn't proven itself against anyone who stayed.
hints: SP+ halves: off #3, def #5.
Strongest metrics: Early pass PPA +2.02, Pts/drive +1.79, Pts/drive +1.60.

teams.explanation: BYU's wins are narrow — 28-24 over Notre Dame, 17-10 at TCU, 24-10 over Iowa State — and its +54 margin ranks #29, but SEI's #6 rides the defense: points per drive allowed +1.7 z, explosive plays allowed +1.6 z, opponents gaining nothing from aggression (+2.2 z, 99th percentile). SP+'s #11 prices the thin margins; our board trusts a defense that held three straight FBS opponents to 10-24 points.
hints: Process outran scoreboard: margin rank #29 (margin +54) but SEI #6.
SP+ halves: off #20, def #9.
Strongest metrics: AR +2.24, Pts/drive +1.68, Exp +1.63.
Weakest metrics: Pen -2.41, AR -1.67.
